summary: Based on evidence through November 6, 2024, no substantive changes are warranted to the existing covenant package; all assumptions remain supported and the current protections remain appropriate.

clauses.rationale: Evidence shows Amazon Break Fee exceeded $24M, so step‑up condition not met; existing mechanics already adjust for received amounts; no change needed.
Timely delivery of financial statements confirmed by quarterly press releases; no going‑concern issues identified; current reporting requirements remain adequate.
Monthly compliance certificate delivery assumption supported by timely reporting evidence; no indication of delays or failures; retain.
Amazon termination fee of $94M received, with $35M immediate repayment and remainder set aside, aligns with existing Break Fee sweep mechanics; no adjustment needed.
No evidence of defaults or notice failures; the notice provision continues to function as intended; retain.

drift_reasons: All available evidence through the review date supports the existing assumptions and shows no triggered conditions that would require tightening, loosening, or adding protections.
